scope: Every request kind declared by the backend-neutral conformance corpus, classified by Rekordbox 7.2.19 database behavior.

families.predicate: Live category rows passing the capability-aware Disable predicate.
families.ordering: djmdCategory.Seq ascending.
families.result: Typed root rows; enabled empty categories remain visible.

families.predicate: Live visible content constrained by GenreID and optional ArtistID and AlbumID; ffffffff removes an intermediate constraint.
families.ordering: Entity labels for hierarchy rows; requested content sort for tracks.
families.result: Genre, artist or ALL, album or ALL, then track rows.

families.predicate: Live visible content constrained by ArtistID and optional AlbumID.
families.ordering: Entity labels; concrete-album tracks default to TrackNo.
families.result: Artist, album or ALL, then track rows.

families.predicate: Referenced live AlbumID followed by live visible content equality.
families.ordering: Album label; concrete-album tracks default to TrackNo.
families.result: Album then track rows.

families.predicate: rb_local_deleted = 0 and Link Export visible FolderPath.
families.ordering: Requested djdsqlFlexSort; default title order.
families.result: Track rows with render-time secondary and compatibility enrichment.

families.predicate: Distinct nonzero rounded BPM; tolerance zero uses [-50,+49] and tolerance 1..6 uses signed percentage bounds.
families.ordering: Numeric BPM; requested content sort for tracks.
families.result: BPM, tolerance, then track rows.

families.predicate: Root advertises Rating 0..5; direct selection can reach stored out-of-domain values.
families.ordering: Numeric selector; requested content sort.
families.result: Rating then track rows.

families.predicate: Nonzero ReleaseYear through 2999 grouped by floor(year / 10) * 10.
families.ordering: Decades and years descending; requested content sort.
families.result: Decade, year or ALL, then track rows.

families.predicate: Live visible content constrained by LabelID and optional ArtistID and AlbumID.
families.ordering: Entity labels; requested content sort for tracks.
families.result: Label, artist or ALL, album or ALL, then track rows.

families.predicate: Root reads every non-deleted djmdKey row; track selection constrains live visible content by the requested KeyID.
families.ordering: Database row order for roots; requested djdsqlFlexSort for tracks.
families.result: Old-Key labels followed by ordinary enriched track rows.

families.predicate: Root advertises palette IDs 1..8; direct equality reaches ColorID zero but not dangling lookup IDs.
families.ordering: Palette order; requested content sort.
families.result: Color then track rows.

families.predicate: Root de-duplicates 16-bit DJPlayCount; track predicate compares one-byte request and stored values.
families.ordering: Counts ascending; requested content sort.
families.result: Play-count then track rows with a low-byte collision boundary.

families.predicate: Live persisted tag-list memberships resolved to live content.
families.ordering: Membership TrackNo for sort zero; requested content sort otherwise.
families.result: Track rows retaining membership position.

families.predicate: Length / 60 minute buckets for lengths through 10799 seconds.
families.ordering: Minute buckets descending; requested content sort.
families.result: Duration bucket then track rows.

families.predicate: Distinct BitRate including zero but excluding stored INT32_MAX; direct equality-like selection.
families.ordering: Numeric bitrate; requested content sort.
families.result: Bitrate then track rows.

families.predicate: Current Link session history and memberships; Windows AppSync history does not apply the FolderPath streaming gate.
families.ordering: History creation order; song insertion and TrackNo order.
families.result: History then track rows.

families.predicate: The same live visible content set as Collection.
families.ordering: Requested content sort; FileNameL remains primary text.
families.result: Track rows with FileNameL primary text.

families.predicate: Normalize historical KeyID and ScaleName variants into 24 harmonic positions, then apply distance 0..2.
families.ordering: Harmonic key order; requested content sort.
families.result: Key, distance, then tracks; labels use DEVSETTING.DAT notation.

families.predicate: Root or group hierarchy for 1015; content ID to assigned group and leaf pairs for 1315.
families.ordering: Stored tag sequence and group-leaf pairing.
families.result: Tag hierarchy or tags assigned to one track.

families.predicate: Seed matches either relationship endpoint; return the opposite endpoint; LikeRate is ignored.
families.ordering: Requested content sort.
families.result: Related track rows.

families.ordering: Playlist Seq; membership TrackNo for sort zero; requested content sort otherwise.
families.result: Folder and playlist rows or filtered track rows.

families.predicate: Enabled Artist, Album, Track, and File Name domains; every token matches and content passes Link Export visibility.
families.ordering: Domain grouping then requested content sort; insertion capped at 1000.
families.result: Mixed entity headings and track rows.

families.predicate: Parse StockDate into year, month, and day; ffffffff takes wildcard branches.

families.result: Metadata rows with category-enabled flags.

families.predicate: AppSync resolves ImagePath directly by content or playlist ID; the Master fallback resolves a content ImageID through djmdImage.
families.ordering: Single identifier lookup; filesystem candidates are tried in loader order.
families.result: JPEG bytes or an empty 4002 response; success additionally requires a recognized image no larger than one MiB.

families.predicate: Resolve one content analysis path, then load the kind-specific waveform, beat-grid, VBR, key, or specified-atom payload; specified atoms admit EXT/2EX and short-circuit PCP2, PCPT, and PMAI.
families.ordering: Single identifier lookup followed by format-specific file parsing.
families.result: Kind-specific direct blob response or an empty kind-specific response when the file, atom, or parser result is unavailable.

families.predicate: Read only the packed context track-type byte, emit request and delivery logs, and return internal -2.
families.ordering: None.
families.result: No payload reply is built.

families.predicate: Resolve cue and extended-cue data for one content ID through the database/callback path.
families.ordering: Stored cue order and callback serialization.

families.predicate: AppSync reads TrackNo 1..3 for one bank ID without validating the owning bank row.
